snippet.title: Dumb Ways to Build | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your tools, we have a job for you! 

Announcing Dumb Ways to Build, a chaotic 1-4 player physics-based  co-op game, where your objective is to complete dangerous construction jobs in the world of Dumb Ways to Die! 

Launching September 10, 2026 across PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with cross-platform support!

See you on the jobsite 🏗️    
    
Wishlist Now
Website: https://www.dumbwaystodie.com/build
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4412320/Dumb_Ways_to_Build
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/Dumb-Ways-to-Build/9N7CB46MF74V
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019972

#dumbwaystodie #build #coop
